# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities to **security@polderlabs.com**.
Do **not** open a public GitHub issue for a security vulnerability.

We aim to acknowledge receipt within 48 hours and provide a timeline for a
fix within 7 days.

## Supported versions

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| 0.1.x   | Yes       |

Only the latest minor release receives security patches. If you are on an
older version, please upgrade before reporting.

## Process

1. Reporter sends details to security@polderlabs.com.
2. Maintainers triage and confirm the vulnerability.
3. A fix is developed on a private branch.
4. A security release is tagged and published.
5. The vulnerability is disclosed after the fix ships.
